summary: A hierarchical multiplicative Marketing Mix Model (MMM) codebase built on PyMC. It models sales/conversions as a multiplicative function of adstocked+saturated channel spend, seasonality, trend, and control variables. Supports geo-level and brand-level hierarchical pooling, calibration to lift experiments, Bayesian priors/constraints, budget optimization via scipy, and automated reporting of ROAS/ROI and response curves.

groups.name: core_modeling
groups.description: Defines the Bayesian PyMC model graph, the multiplicative likelihood, hierarchical pooling layers, and NUTS/ADVI sampling logic.

files.role: Main model builder. Constructs the PyMC multiplicative MMM model, wires adstock/saturation transforms, seasonality, trend, and hierarchical intercepts. Entry point for pm.sample().
files.recommended_reuse: Copy as the model scaffold; replace channel list and likelihood family as needed.

files.role: Abstract base class for MMM models. Defines the fit/predict/score interface, shared preprocessing hooks, idata I/O, and plotting dispatch.
files.recommended_reuse: Subclass for custom model variants; override _build_model() and keep fit/predict interface.

files.role: Generic PyMC model scaffolding: prior predictive sampling, posterior sampling, MCMC config validation, and idata serialisation. Shared by MMM and CLV modules.
files.recommended_reuse: Use ModelBuilder.fit() directly; configure via sampler_config dict (draws, tune, chains, target_accept).

files.role: Component registry for plug-in adstock and saturation transforms. Each component exposes apply() and contributes PyMC variables to the active model context.
files.recommended_reuse: Register custom transforms here; avoids touching mmm.py directly.

groups.name: transformations
groups.description: Adstock (carryover) and saturation (diminishing returns) transforms applied to raw channel spend before entering the model. Vectorised for PyMC tensor operations.

files.role: Implements geometric and Weibull adstock. geometric_adstock() is the standard; weibull_adstock() used for long-lag channels (TV, OOH). Both vectorised over channels.
files.recommended_reuse: Use geometric_adstock() as default; switch to weibull_adstock() for TV/OOH. Alpha prior: Beta(2,2).

files.role: Implements Hill (S-curve) and logistic saturation. Hill is default; logistic used when theoretical max market size is known.
inputs: slope (k) and half-saturation (K_half) or logistic params
files.recommended_reuse: Default to Hill saturation. Set K_half prior centred near observed median spend per channel.

files.role: Legacy transformer classes (GeometricAdstockTransformer, HillSaturationTransformer) kept for backwards compatibility. The components/ directory is the preferred API.
files.recommended_reuse: Prefer components/ API for new projects; use transformers/ only if integrating with older client codebases.

groups.name: priors_constraints
groups.description: Centralised prior specifications and hard constraints for all model parameters. Loaded from YAML; enforced at model-build time.

files.role: Reads prior specs (dict or YAML) and constructs PyMC prior distributions for each parameter group (intercept, channel coefs, adstock, saturation, noise). Enforces positivity constraints on channel contributions.
inputs: prior spec dict or YAML path
files.recommended_reuse: Always load from YAML; override individual priors per-channel if experiment data available.

files.role: Custom prior families not in standard PyMC: HalfStudentT, MvNormalNonCentered, and MonotonicallyIncreasing for budget response constraints.
files.recommended_reuse: Use MvNormalNonCentered for correlated channel effects; HalfStudentT for heavier-tailed noise.

files.role: Master run config: channel list, date column, KPI column, geo column, model variant (national/geo/hierarchical), sampler settings (draws, tune, chains, target_accept), and output paths.
outputs: config dict consumed by run pipeline
files.recommended_reuse: Primary config file to clone per project; update channel names and KPI column first.

files.role: Geo-specific config: geo list, geo-to-region mapping, holdout geo flags for lift calibration, geo spend columns.
outputs: geo config consumed by geo model variant
files.recommended_reuse: Clone per geo project; populate holdout_geos with experiment control geos.

groups.name: calibration
groups.description: Calibrates posterior channel contributions to geo-lift / incrementality experiments via likelihood penalties or informative priors on ROAS.

files.role: Implements geo-lift calibration: translates experiment-measured lift % into an ROAS target, then adds a likelihood penalty (Normal or LogNormal) to the model log-prob to pull channel contribution posteriors toward the experiment estimate.
inputs: experiment results dict (geo, channel, lift_pct, spend)
files.recommended_reuse: Always apply when geo-lift or conversion-lift experiments are available. Sigma of calibration Normal = 0.2 * measured_roas by default.

files.role: Defines the canonical column schema: spend column names, impressions columns, cost-per-unit fields, and channel-to-media-type mapping. Used across data loading, transformations, and reporting.
files.recommended_reuse: Always populate ColumnConfig first when onboarding a new client; drives all downstream column references.

files.role: Loads and validates YAML config files. Provides get_config() singleton and raises descriptive errors on missing/invalid fields.
files.recommended_reuse: Use get_config() as the single config access point; add new fields with defaults to avoid breaking existing configs.

groups.name: validation
groups.description: Posterior predictive checks, holdout backtesting, MAPE/WAPE metrics, convergence diagnostics (R-hat, ESS), and sanity checks on channel contributions.

files.role: Provides plot_posterior_predictive(), get_errors(), and score() methods. Computes in-sample MAPE and holds idata for downstream diagnostics.
files.recommended_reuse: Call model.get_errors() after sampling; gate delivery on MAPE < 10% and all R-hat < 1.01.

files.role: Documents the column config schema fix: explains why a breaking change was made to column_config.py and how to migrate existing configs. Useful as a change-log reference.
files.recommended_reuse: Read before cloning column_config.py to avoid the pre-fix schema pitfalls.

files.role: Comprehensive bug-fix record covering decorator issues, column config issues, and model build errors. Documents root cause and resolution for each.
files.recommended_reuse: Reference when debugging model build errors; many common issues documented here.

groups.name: reporting
groups.description: Generates response curves, contribution decomposition, ROAS/ROI tables, and formatted client-ready output files.

files.role: Provides plot_channel_contribution_share_of_total(), get_channel_contributions_share_of_total(), and plot_direct_contribution_curves() for client reporting.
files.recommended_reuse: Call plot_channel_contribution_share_of_total() for client deck visuals; always show 89% HDI.

files.role: Step-by-step guide for running the full pipeline from data load to report. Includes example config snippets and expected output shapes.
files.recommended_reuse: Share with new team members as the first reference; contains end-to-end worked example.

groups.name: optimization
groups.description: Budget allocation optimizer using posterior response curves and scipy constrained optimization.

files.role: Provides optimize_budget() method: sweeps response curves, runs SLSQP optimisation to maximise expected KPI given a total spend constraint, returns optimal spend vector and expected lift.
files.recommended_reuse: Use optimize_budget() with posterior mean curves; also run with HDI bounds to report uncertainty in allocation.

groups.name: data_ingestion
groups.description: Data loading, validation, and preprocessing pipeline that converts raw client data into model-ready arrays.

files.role: Canonical column schema definition. Maps client column names to internal schema; validates presence of required columns at load time.
files.recommended_reuse: Start here when onboarding a new client dataset; populate before writing any preprocessing code.

files.role: Loads and validates YAML config files. Provides get_config() singleton with descriptive error messages on invalid fields.
files.recommended_reuse: Single config access point across the pipeline; extend with new fields using Optional with defaults.

entry_points: QUICK_START.md -- step-by-step pipeline walkthrough with example config
pymc_marketing/mmm/mmm.py -- MMM class: mmm = MMM(**config); mmm.fit(X, y); mmm.get_channel_contributions()
pymc_marketing/mmm/base.py -- MMMBase.fit() for programmatic pipeline use
key_dependencies: pymc-marketing (the package itself; pip install pymc-marketing)

mmm_specific_notes.model_form: Multiplicative: KPI ~ base * prod(channel_contributions_i) * noise (or additive variant via likelihood param)
mmm_specific_notes.adstock_choices: geometric_adstock (default, paid digital); weibull_adstock (TV, OOH, long-lag channels)
mmm_specific_notes.saturation_choices: Hill saturation (default); logistic when theoretical market size cap is known
mmm_specific_notes.hierarchical_pooling: Partial pooling available via non-centered parameterisation; geo- and brand-level group effects on intercept and channel betas
mmm_specific_notes.calibration_approach: Geo-lift experiments -> ROAS target -> Normal likelihood penalty (sigma = 0.2 * measured_roas by default)
mmm_specific_notes.convergence_thresholds: R-hat < 1.01, bulk-ESS > 400, divergences < 1% of draws — hard gates before reporting
mmm_specific_notes.roas_reporting: Posterior mean + 89% HDI per channel; decomposition validates sum-to-total
mmm_specific_notes.optimization: SLSQP constrained optimization on posterior mean response curves; run also on HDI bounds for uncertainty range
mmm_specific_notes.key_pitfall: Always check column_config.py schema match before first model run; most build errors trace to column name mismatches (see COMPLETE_FIX_SUMMARY.md)
